digest.component_or_area: rebar.llm public API — external live tests
propositions: The public API rebar.llm.review_ticket() was removed pre-1.0 but two external test modules (test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py and test_llm_trace.py) still call it, causing AttributeError in 4 CI lanes (external LLM live anthropic/openai/bedrock and langfuse tracing round-trip).

External tests are excluded from the standard Gerrit Verified gate, so the removal epic's validation never exercised these call sites and the regression remained invisible until live workflow_dispatch execution.

review_plan() cannot satisfy the existing test assertions because it returns PLAN_REVIEW_VERDICT (no top-level findings field) whereas both tests validate REVIEW_RESULT schema with result['runner'], result['model'], result['findings'].
Both external test modules were retargeted to rebar.llm.review_code() (a surviving public op returning REVIEW_RESULT with the required runner/model/findings contract) rather than review_plan().

Retargeting was validated live: test_pydantic_review_code_opus passed on bedrock arm, and authoritative workflow_dispatch run 31856166064 showed all three LLM provider lanes (anthropic/openai/bedrock) and langfuse lane GREEN with zero 'review_ticket' AttributeError occurrences.
